title: NewsAttention: software and documents for a daily dataset of news events and Wikipedia page views
description: The software that builds NewsAttention, with its documents (method, sources, licenses, data card, release layout, corrections and removals). NewsAttention links each day's news events, as English Wikipedia's Current Events Portal lists them, to how many people read the Wikipedia articles each event links to: by language edition (exact daily counts from the Wikimedia Analytics API) and by country (Wikimedia's published, privacy-protected daily counts, used as published), with measures of attention (baseline, lift, excess views, peak day, half-life, breadth). Version 0.1.0 holds 21,997 events from 2023-02-06 to 2026-11-22 and their daily views from 2023-01-09 to 2026-11-22. This archive holds the code and documents only, no data table. The dataset itself is published on Hugging Face (obadakr/newsattention), with a mirror of the same tables on Kaggle (obadakraishan/newsattention); the counts, links and measures are under CC0 1.0 and the event text under CC BY-SA 4.0. NewsAttention is not affiliated with the Wikimedia Foundation.
